headline: OpenAI consults elite mathematicians to avoid future fumbles.
summary: OpenAI seeks advice from human mathematicians after a reputational crisis. A new independent panel will guide AI companies on mathematical research. The goal is to prevent future missteps in interacting with the math community.

headline: Paramount's merger with Warner Bros. Discovery demands more movies.
summary: Paramount settled lawsuits, nearing its $110 billion merger with WBD. The studio must now become one of the world's largest production houses. It's committed to spending at least $300 million more on new film and TV projects.

headline: Rabbit's new AI agent no longer needs an R1 device to run.
summary: Rabbit's underwhelming R1 device is no longer necessary for its new AI agent. The OS3 'agentic operating system' now runs entirely in the cloud. It operates locally across Windows, Mac, and Linux devices.

headline: Saudi Arabia unveils wild 'Exobot' EVs that make Cybertrucks look normal.
summary: Saudi startup Ceer revealed a pair of hyper-angular, spaceship-like Exobot EVs. This marks Saudi Arabia's surprising entry into electric vehicle manufacturing. Their unique design stands out, even compared to the Cybertruck.

headline: Gears of War: E-Day Story Director laid off just before early access launch.
summary: Gears of War: E-Day's story director was unexpectedly laid off. The dismissal occurred only one week before the game's early access launch. This sudden development creates uncertainty for the upcoming release.

headline: Wolverine's narrative director explains why Logan is a 'short king' in the game.
summary: Wolverine's narrative director explained Logan's notably shorter stature in the game. This design choice was crucial to highlight his emotional dynamic with Sabretooth. The physical contrast emphasizes their complex relationship.

headline: Save $1,050 on the Alienware 16X Aurora RTX 5060 Gaming Laptop at Walmart.
summary: Get a massive $1,050 discount on the Alienware 16X Aurora gaming laptop. This premium device boasts an all-metal build, a stunning OLED display, and Intel's most powerful mobile CPU. The deal is part of Walmart's GeForce Week Sale.

headline: State of Decay dev Undead Labs confirms 'significant' layoffs after Xbox independence.
summary: Undead Labs, developer of State of Decay 3, has confirmed significant layoffs. The workforce reduction follows the studio's independence from Xbox. The company is undergoing restructuring in the wake of this separation.

headline: UK to combat Russian disinformation, lead global AI standards, PM says.
summary: The UK aims to intensify its fight against Russian disinformation efforts. The Prime Minister announced a push for global AI regulatory standards. The UK seeks to position itself as an 'honest broker' on key global challenges.

headline: Chris Mason: How Burnham survived his tense first meeting with Trump.
summary: BBC political editor Chris Mason recounts Burnham's nervous first encounter with Trump. Burnham was wary of Trump's often explosive interactions. The report details how Burnham navigated the challenging meeting successfully.

headline: UK to review Chagos Islands deal after Trump's latest criticism.
summary: The UK government will review the Chagos Islands deal. This decision follows strong criticism from US President Trump, who called the agreement 'terrible.' Defence Secretary Wes Streeting confirmed the upcoming review.

headline: Women warn about open wounds, unable to close eyes from cheap eyelid surgery abroad.
summary: Doctors report a concerning rise in complications from cheap blepharoplasty abroad. Women are sharing experiences of open wounds and inability to close eyes. The warnings highlight the risks of seeking cosmetic treatment overseas.
